version: v11 (2026-10-16), restyle of figures/figure_spec_v10_F3.json; numbers unchanged
message: Year-specific climate input, the validation split and the covariate set determine how much physics + residual ML gains over recalibrated Stefan; the gain is largest where Stefan errs most.
medium: Scientific Reports, double column, 180 mm wide, fixed canvas (no tight bbox)

style.font: FreeSans 7 pt (ticks and direct labels 6.5 pt, heat-map values 6 pt), panel letters 8 pt bold; text #262626 (white only inside dark heat-map cells, chosen by WCAG contrast)
style.lines: axes and ticks 0.5 pt #404040; data lines 0.8-1.0 pt (Physics + residual ML 1.0, Stefan recalibrated and Direct ML 0.9, Stefan source 0.8); zero/reference 0.5 pt #8C8C8C; light grid #E8E8E8 0.4 pt at major ticks of the value axis
style.markers: circles 3.5 pt, squares 3.1 pt (equal area), Stefan source squares 3.0 pt, Direct ML open circles 3.4 pt (edge 0.6 pt)
style.methods: Stefan (source coeff.) #8C9BAB squares; Stefan (recalibrated) #2E6DA4 squares; Physics + residual ML #D1603D filled circles; Direct ML #8E5B9E dashed, open circles
style.regions: v11 colours + marker shapes: Alaska #3B3B8F circle, Lena Delta #4A90C2 square, Canada (NW) #3A9384 triangle (white 0.35 pt marker edge)
style.heat_map: cmcrameri vik, limits -7 to +7 cm (symmetric about 0); white 0.5 mm cell gaps; dark-grey 0.8 pt outline centred on the cell edge = 95% interval excludes 0; light grey hatching = insufficient data; both symbols keyed below the heat map

layout: row 1: a (3 region panels, slope chart 2011-2024 mean vs year-specific climate input; input = x position) | b (3 region panels, RMSE by validation split, rotated tick labels); row 2: c (interval plot by covariate set, region legend lower right) | d (tercile heat map + colour bar + key row). One method legend at the top.
changes_from_v10: v11 colours (v10 black/grey for Direct ML and regions)
dark-grey text and axes instead of black
light grid lines in a, b (y) and c (x)
a: markers identify methods only (v10 open/filled markers for the climate input removed); x ticks '2011-2024 mean' and 'Year-specific' (v10 'Obs. year')
c and Fig. 4a: axis label 'ΔRMSE vs recalibrated Stefan (cm)' (v10 'ΔRMSE vs Stefan, recal. (cm)')
d: outline dark grey and centred on the cell edge (visible on dark cells); key text '95% interval excludes 0' (v10 '95% CI excludes 0'); value colour by contrast ratio
c: region key on a white backing; d: key swatch = outline on the neutral colour

a.filter: scheme block, featset F8TS, forcing clim and year_obs; P1, R1 (catboost, lam 0.5), D0 (catboost)
a.years: labels 2010-2024 (Lena 2010-2022); mean climate = 2011-2024 ERA5-Land mean; year-specific = TDD to observation day

b.filter: forcing year_obs, featset F8TS; schemes random, block, year, block_year, region; P0, P1, R1 (catboost, lam 0.5), D0 (catboost)
b.out_of_range: values > 1.3 x max of the non-region splits are drawn on the top edge with the value printed

c.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, ref P1, method R1 catboost lam 0.5; modis_v6 (MODIS 2010-2024) preferred over featsets_v6 for F8TS, F8TS_M, F8TS_ALL, as in v6_numbers.py and v7_f4_results_core.py

d.filter: covariate != all; shown = n >= 30 cell-years and >= 5 blocks; excludes_0 from 2000 block-bootstrap resamples

qa: 2026-10-16 independent review (visual-reviewer, 600 dpi crops of all six figures). Fixed: Fig. 3c region key on a white backing (grid lines ran through it); Fig. 3d key swatch now shows the outline on the neutral (zero) colour; Fig. 4c thin bracket joins the Liu 2024 / Wei 2026 lines next to 'trained on these sites' (note already on a white backing); S1c lighter Alaska density tints; S3 group colours shifted 3-8 % so 6 pt numbers reach >= 4.5:1 contrast; S10 small horizontal dodge per series. Kept by design: out-of-range values drawn on the top edge with the value printed (token rule symbols.out_of_range; arrows/triangles forbidden); Fig. 4c Stefan (recalibrated) as a light halo under Physics + residual ML (curves within 0.55 cm, keyed in the panel); S2 regions by marker shape only (colour encodes model structure); Stefan squares vs Lena Delta squares (both fixed by the palette and marker specs; never in the same panel). Automatic QA after fixes: 0 problems in all six figures; 13 plotted values spot-checked against the source CSVs, all match.

qa_automatic.checks: fig34_common11.qa: font >= 6 pt, text colour #262626 or white, text-text overlap, text outside canvas, text over foreign axes, in-axes labels touching lines/markers; pdffonts: FreeSans/FreeSansBold embedded (CID TrueType); svg text kept as text; numbers equal to v10 source data (546 numeric values)

marker_rule: Stefan methods squares, ML methods circles; Direct ML open circles, dashed; regions circle / square / triangle
